headline: Day after FOMC: leading indicators favor a counter-trend squeeze higher into resistance (buy the dip) — but crude is the decider for whether the aggressive bear setup activates.
market_state: Day AFTER FOMC; regime back to inflationary bust (most dangerous — all financial assets can fall together). Econ 8:30: Advance GDP, core PCE, unemployment claims (exp 201k), personal income/spending; nat-gas 10:30. Fed-watch: a Sept hike to 3.75-4.0 now priced (from 3.50-3.75); 2nd hike pushed to March. USD-indices correlations deepening negative; gold/silver/BTC negative-correlation fading toward neutral. Month-end tomorrow -> gold's first GREEN monthly candle of 2026 = perceived first support.
bias: Short-term BULLISH counter-trend squeeze into resistance (path of least resistance): dollar in a pullback, bank longs unbroken, VIX in 50% shorts, gap stats 68% no-fill outside the 30-handle. The bear setup activates only when the dollar changes trend + bank breaks its long + VIX pierces its shorts + crude defends its HWB long. CRUDE is the decider.

es.current_mm: Completed a profit target at Monday's resistance; nothing unusual about coming all-the-way-HWB again -> next full retracement up at 7478. Currently a pro gap-up-and-go.
es.trend: Range-bound; repeating weekly pattern: short-squeeze -> grind higher -> crowd chases green bars -> break extensions at resistance -> roll over -> repeat.

key_levels.label: Edge is NO fill (68% keep grinding), 180d

es.watch: Buy the dip intraday for the squeeze; confirm resistance by breaking the counter-trend longs from lows. The more aggressive bear setup = Monday highs->lows (further away) — needs the leading indicators to flip.

key_quotes.text: It is the day after FOMC... inflationary bust — all financial assets go down potentially, the most dangerous part of the market.
Crude oil is going to tell us everything that we need to know about this week's price action.
We're grinding higher, and it would be better to buy the dip in the intraday timeframe to take advantage of that squeeze.
